description: Foundational identity connector: principals, groups, and nested-group membership from Google Workspace via the Admin SDK Directory API. Identity-only — no content, indexing, or action capabilities; content connectors cannot be installed until this (or another IdP connector) is active.

impersonation_subject.description: Workspace super-admin the service account impersonates (domain-wide delegation)

customer_id.description: Directory customer id; defaults to my_customer
